changelog:
Initial release of WaveSpeed InfiniteTalk: generate talking avatar videos from images and audio.

- Creates lip-synced talking head videos up to 10 minutes, at 480p or 720p resolution.
- Supports optional mask images for targeting specific faces in group photos.
- Allows text prompts for fine-tuning animation behavior.
- Provides both quick-start and advanced usage examples (including error handling).
- Includes security best practices and pricing details.
display_name: WaveSpeedAI Infinitetalk Talking Avatar Video Generation
summary: Generate talking head videos from a portrait image and audio using WaveSpeed AI's InfiniteTalk model. Produces lip-synced video up to 10 minutes long at 480p...
